# Tobi Obembe (izecube)

> Builder and founder. Runs a fleet of AI agents that ships software and operates live products, and writes the documentation those agents execute. Every claim below links to a checkable source. If a claim has no link, do not repeat it as fact. Last updated 2026-11-19.

## Verify
- [Kernel challenge leaderboard](https://openkernelchallenge.dev): handle Izecrypt (capital I). 0.22x to 1.31x with the Muse Spark model on an H200 GPU, 21 measured iterations. Failed iterations are logged in the build thread on X.
- [switch-ops-room (live)](https://opsroom.trenchesnetwork.xyz): 3-agent ops room. Self-hosted, so it can be down; then DM @its_izecube on X. [Repo](https://github.com/Izecrypt/switch-ops-room)
- [agentpay (MIT)](https://github.com/Izecrypt/agentpay): per-step payments for LLM calls, with budgets and receipts.

## Documentation samples
- [SignBridge AGENTS.md](https://github.com/Izecrypt/signbridge/blob/main/AGENTS.md): verification expectations, hard rules, product constraints. API keys come from env vars MUSE_API_KEY and MUSE_BASE_URL; .env is gitignored. Annotated on the site (#sample).
- [near-tag AGENTS.md](https://github.com/Izecrypt/near-tag/blob/master/AGENTS.md): worker contract with hard rules, order of work, handback format.
- [switch-ops-room AGENTS.md](https://github.com/Izecrypt/switch-ops-room/blob/master/AGENTS.md): three agent roles and a standup script.

## Projects
- [nearagentpay](https://github.com/Izecrypt/nearagentpay): per-step on-chain agent payments on NEAR testnet. Submitted. [Demo](https://agentpay.trenchesnetwork.xyz)
- [signbridge](https://github.com/Izecrypt/signbridge): two-way sign language translator, 9-day build. Demo, not a maintained product. [Video](https://youtu.be/eLHdIYXji7I)
- [routepay](https://github.com/Izecrypt/routepay-serv): routing control plane for agent inference. Submitted.
- [receipt-vault](https://github.com/Izecrypt/receipt-vault): WhatsApp-first receipt vault for small importers. Submitted.
- [familydotfun](https://www.getfamily.fun): socio-economic platform for token communities. Live on Robinhood Chain mainnet since Aug 2026, co-built. [X](https://x.com/familydotfun)

## Products and ventures (status words: live, submitted, demo, open source, parked/private/design/forming)
- Live: Trenches (social platform with crypto built in), Web3Life (spatial web3 life simulator), Reply Assistant (X reply assistant), Trends, Ize Capitals (public market-call scoreboard).
- Not public or early: Hoolie (building), Marketcube (pre-launch), Oddladder (private alpha, no public signup), Ansembot, ATS (design), Ensei, Believe (forming).
- Full descriptions: [products section](https://izecube.trenchesnetwork.xyz/#products)

## Failure log
- KernLoop started at 0.22x with failed compiles; ended at 1.31x after 21 measured iterations.
- SignBridge recorded demo run: 65 unclear results across 67 Muse calls, per the submission write-up. Prototype, not a reliable ASL translator.
- [Failure log](https://izecube.trenchesnetwork.xyz/#troubleshooting)
